scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @queuekit/shared && npm run build -w @queuekit/redis-toolkit && npm run build -w @queuekit/queue-toolkit
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @queuekit/api
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @queuekit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @queuekit/redis-toolkit && npm run typecheck -w @queuekit/queue-toolkit && npm run typecheck -w @queuekit/api && npm run typecheck -w @queuekit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @queuekit/api && npm run lint -w @queuekit/web
